notes.title: New high level combat zone, new jewelry tasks, dozens of new items & much more!
notes.content:
Foreword on the Next Update
With more and more items being added into the game, it's becoming increasingly difficult and annoying to swap items around to get most out of the activities you're doing. As such, the next update is going to focus on a loadout/preset system that'll allow you to create different layouts for a range of activities in the game that you can then easily switch between without having to scavenge through your entire inventory. Some other requested inventory management options may or may not make it into that update - we'll see how much time loadouts end up taking!

Anyway, onto this update!
New

A new high level combat zone has been added: Lair of beasts!
  
  6 new enemies to defeat
  The enemies have exceptionally high health and defence but are fairly modest in strength. This means that with enough food, you'll be able to grind them out without needing to have very high combat stats (though it certainly helps). As their defences are so high, you'll find that raid weapons work very well against them - but they aren't required. Group combat should also prove more beneficial here than in the previous zones!
  Drop tables offer new, tradeable and equipable unique items. You can check out the new monster drop tables in-game for specific information on them:
    
    Centaur's shield & helmet
    Necromancer's hat & boots
    Minotaur's horns
    Chef's hat
    Warrior's platebody
    Granite shield
    Dragonscale shield & boots
    Artisan's boots
    Treasure hunter gloves (offers a 50% higher chance of finding chests when doing Agility)
    Silver, gold & diamond symbols for the new craftable jewelry. More on the uses for these in the next bullet point.
    
  Skilling consumables introduction. When you have these in your inventory, you'll receive some bonus experience for every completed task and the material will be lost in the process. When you have these in your inventory and attempt to start a task, you'll be asked if you want to use them for the requested task.
    
    Common fishing bait/Rare fishing bait: 2%/4% more experience for every fish caught
    Common resin/Rare resin: 2%/4% more experience for every log chopped
    Common gem dust/Rare gem dust: 2%/4% more experience for ore mined
    Common flax essence/Rare flax essence: 2%/4% more experience for every resource foraged
    Common compost/Rare compost: 2%/4% more experience for every farmed ingredient
    Common vial/Rare vial: 2%/4% more experience for every brewed potion
    

  New craftable rings and bracelets:
    
    Currently, rings are good for melee and bracelets are good for magic. Kind of lame. We're adding in new variants of rings and bracelets to suit every combat style:
      
      Berserker ring (strength bonus)
      Brute bracelet (strength bonus)
      Precision ring (archery bonus)
      Marksman's bracelet (archery bonus)
      Arcane ring (magic bonus)
      Sorcerer bracelet (magic bonus)
      
    To create these rings and bracelets, you'll need to get your hands on some new symbols dropped by a variety of monsters. Silver symbols can be found killing low level monsters, gold symbols from med level monsters and diamond ones from the new enemies found in the Lair of beasts, as previously mentioned. To create these jewelery variants, you'll need the regular base jewelery and a symbol. You're also able to transfer your existing enchantments from an enchanted ring and bracelet into one of these variants: just start the appropriate jewerly smithing task with your enchanted jewerly in your inventory.
    Existing rings had their strength bonuses lowered or removed and all rings and bracelets were given some accuracy for all combat styles. To do more damage, you'll now need to upgrade your rings and bracelets. The upgraded rings and bracelet will offer significantly more DPS than the jewelry previously did.
    
  
Changes

 A 1% tax has been added to player shop transactions to put a little dent into the ever increasing inflation that games like ours face. For example, this means that you'll receive 99 gold for an item you sold for 100 gold. The buyer will pay the full 100 gold and the game will delete the taxed amount
 Clan event duration lowered from 3 to 2 minutes
 Ironman achievements are now posted into a separate Discord channel by Idle Clans Bot
 Time spent in a raid is now shown next to the party size text in raids
 Chatbox commands can now be used without having 100 total or being premium
 Archer's shield's archery accuracy was decreased from 25 to 17
 Divine buckler's archery accuracy was raised from 25 to 31 and magic defence bonus from 30 to 55
 Archer's hat's archery accuracy was raised from 3 to 6 and level requirement lowered from 40 to 30
 "Strength", "Accuracy" and "Defence" stats in item descriptions are now displayed as "Melee strength", "Melee accuracy" and "Melee defence" for consistency and clarity
 Gained experiences in login popup will no longer show decimal places

 Experiences in Leaderboards now have decimal places for better readability
 When hovering skills that you've already maxed out, the experience target for the next (current) level will no longer show up
 Item enchantments are now always displayed in the same order
 Updated Ninja's description to mention that it also works in Reckoning of the Gods

Bug Fixes

 Earrings slot silhouette is no longer a helmet in the clan member profile popup
 Fixed going to combat from the activities popup causing some UI to be incorrectly hidden
 Fixed a bug where raid weapons would appear to apply their special effect even on monsters that weren't weak to their attack styles (mistake in calculation was only client-side/visual)

 Fixed a rare situation where you could be put into different lobbies for the same clan event
 Fixed clan members not being removed from any on-going clan events when leaving the clan

notes.title: 19th of September updates - Clan events, clan bulletin board & more
notes.content:
Updates

The first clan event has been added! It focuses on gathering skills and plays out exactly how minigames used to. Each clan member can complete the event 4 times per day and the events by default have a 1 hour cooldown. More on that later. You can run the event alone or together with up to all of your clan members. Doing it in large groups is incentivized by providing a 2% experience boost to the experience you receive from the event for every participating clan member.

 There are 4 different possible events, one for each gathering skill: Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing and Foraging. The event you get is randomized every time you start an event.
The higher your level and boosts from your equipment for the selected skill, the more points you receive. The more points you receive, the more loot and experience you receive from the event.
The event rewards come with some new unique items: skilling outfits for every gathering skill! Each piece of the outfits give a 2% speed boost to your skilling, similarly to tools and enchantments.
2 new related clan upgrades have added: one that raises the max daily completions of the event from 4 to 6 and one that removes the event cooldown.

A bulletin board has been added to help improve clan communication.

The clan leader and deputy leaders are able to post announcements for the clan to see.
The clan leader and deputy leaders are able to set up a button to link to their Discord channels to more easily get members involved in their communities.


Changes

Various, minor UI scaling related improvements.

Fixed Plundering loot from Raids not being removed drop table as it should with level up thresholds changing.

notes.title: June 8th updates - Toolbelt item & upgrades, new task, offline potions & more
notes.content:
Hello everyone, hope your summers are off to a great start! Let's have a look at the what's been going on in Idle Clans during the last couple of weeks.

iOS Release:
Getting Idle Clans on iOS has been a major focus in the past few weeks, and I'm thrilled to announce that it has been approved on the App Store. However, some final touches are needed before its official release. Barring any unexpected issues, I anticipate launching the iOS version next week.

Upcoming Update:
Before diving into the current updates, I wanted to provide a brief overview of what's coming next. I will be working on fresh and juicy content for both individuals and clans, catering to your feedback and suggestions. Since this will be a substantial undertaking, the update may take longer than the usual two weeks. I'll keep you informed about the progress in our Discord channel's #game-workshop channel.

Updates:

A new item has been added: Toolbelt. It's an equippable item that goes into the new Belt equipment slot. It's currently obtainable from rare and exceptional treasure chests (8% and 4% drop chances respectively), but will likely be moved to future content as something more fitting comes along. The Toolbelt on its own does not offer anything beyond some minimal defensive stats - you'll need to purchase the new Toolbelt upgrade for the item to utilize your tools. Once upgraded and equipped, the toolbelt will provide the benefit of the highest level tool in your inventory for a given task without needing to equip the tool. Tier 1: unlocks Woodcutting and Fishing tools, costs 500K gold
Tier 2: unlocks Mining and Smithing tools, costs 1M gold

notes.title: 22nd of May updates - New upgrade, new plundering task, QoL changes & much more
notes.content:
Starting off with a honourable mention for Noscar for kindly offering us his time and giving our website some much needed love. It looks exponentially better than it did before. Thank you Noscar!

The server has been running very smoothly since the last update and I'm starting to feel the pressure ease up from all of that. Lots of bugs have been squashed and there are still some less urgent ones left to deal with, but now with the bigger fires put out I'm starting to be able to focus on new content and more meaningful updates for the game. It's building up to be a great summer for Idle Clans!

From here on out, I'm going to commit to pushing an update biweekly. Updates may occasionally pop up more often than that if something urgent needs taking care of, or it could take longer if there's larger content update coming up that doesn't make it into the 2 week sprint. I'll be sure to update the community in those cases though. The next update target as such is 5th of June.

On to the game updates!
Updates

 A new upgrade has been added: Boss slayer. It costs a modest 25M gold and once unlocked, will allow you to repeatedly fight the same boss until your keys run out. The upgrade works for groups too and if any group member has it unlocked, it'll be active for the group leader as well.
 A new popup has been added to group combat to better keep track of how the group is doing. It contains the collected loot + dealt & taken damage for each player in the group. It can be manually accessed from the "Loot and stats" view, but it will also show automatically when you leave a group or when the run comes to a natural end.
 A new Plundering task, the Sports center, has been added. It has a level 60 requirement to start and drops the new Agility training tool, the Jumping rope
 A new dish has been added: Beef stew! It has a level 80 requirement and heals 19 health upon consumption. You'll need 2 potatoes, 4 carrots and a piece of cooked quality meat to prepare it.
 Game rules have been added to our website and are accessible in the game from the settings popup

Changes

 Changes to how boosts from enchantments and potions are applied. Currently in the game, they provide a flat bonus to your stats instead of multiplying your actual stats by a given percentage. This caused a very noticable imbalance in the game's combat, especially from mid-game onwards. You would stop taking damage from high level monsters much sooner than made sense and bosses would become too easy to take on even solo. For example, if you had a 50% chance to block attacks from demons and wore 4 pieces of diamond jewelry with defence enchantments, your block chance would raise from 50% to 70% (4x5%). The 20% will now be applied to your base 50% block chance instead of adding on top of it, so in this scenario you would now have a 60% block chance.
 As higher level players have already seen, the skilling speed cap (80%) is currently too easily obtainable and causes a greater influx of items throughout the game than what is good for the economy. In an effort to improve the balance here, housing upgrades and clan housing now give a flat experience boost to skills similarly to the ad boost rather than decreasing the time it takes to complete skilling tasks.
 Yoink chance has been lowered from 25% to 15%. 25% was decided upon when you were still limited to having 1 key a a time. Now with the design of that changed, Yoink needed a little bit of fine tuning as well
 Combat will now continue on log in after combat offline progress
 Rewrote the login limiter system. You should no longer incorrectly be locked out from the game on any OS/platform
 Idle Clans Bot will now include the player receiving loot and the loot itself in the "boss defeated" message
 Bosses now drop ore instead of bars and raw food in place of cooked food
 Max experience in a skill is now 500M
 Experience in maxed skills will no longer show as "Maxed" but keep on showing the experience post-120
 Potion of forgery will no longer work on Astronomical bars
 Confirmation popup will now be shown when attempting to sell enchanted gear and tools
 Gemstones, clubs and the Royal clan icon have had their graphics updated (ty Madao!)
 Small city plundering task requirement was lowered from 55 to 50
 Premium and boss hunter status are now shown at the bottom right of the profile where boosts used to be
 Tasks now display how many of the relevant items you own

Fixes

 Fixed Enchanting level requirements not being enforced correctly client side when dragging scrolls from inventory to equipment
 Zeus had a higher chance of dropping nothing than intended, fixed
 Fixed some mistakes in client side DPS calcs. Additionally, as combat uses a high amount of RNG, simulations are now ran in the client side calcs to provide more realistic calculations. As a result, you'll see slightly different hit chances and DPS each time you open the damage calcs popup.
 Fixed an issue with ad boost and offline progress. The experience boost was correctly factored in on the server, but the server was sending the unmodified experience to the client causing you to see incorrect numbers on login
 Fixed damage dealt during offline combat being shown incorrectly when you had an ad boost active during offline time
 Fixed a visual experience desync that would occasionally occur when resuming an offline task upon logging in
 Fixed whitelists not resetting when logging from one account to another when the second account didn't have any whitelisted players
 Fixed a visual issue with ad boost calculations in Task stats popup
 Accounts logged out during a tutorial task had some trouble processing offline progress tasks when they logged back in. Offline progress is now disabled for players that are in the middle of the tutorial.
 Fixed loot tables never rolling the highest amount available (e.g. the 1-2 Exceptional chest drop from bosses would only ever drop 1 chest)
 Rewrote automatic eating in combat, should no longer get the rare issue in group combat where swapping food slots throws an error and causes the team to disband
 Fixed bosses being potentially accessible without enforcing the key requirement if you knew your way around the client and packet protocols. Thanks kloppie5 for finding the issue and reporting it
 Removed the "Doing this will end group combat" confirmation request popup when the player tried to start another task while in group combat. That is no longer how it works.
 Fixed enemies starting at no health instead of their actual max health in offline progress logic
 Fixed experience and item animations occasionally stopping animating after relogs
 Fixed an issue where if you tried to send an item to another player that you no longer owned you would get a never ending loading animation
 Fixed an annoying issue where sending private messages would sometimes throw you into the incorrect chatbox channel
 When a chat was removed from your chatbox, such as the combat team channel upon your team being disbanded, you would get sent to the default channel. You will now only be sent to the general channel if you were currently active in the channel that was deleted
 Fixed an issue with group combat eating
 Combat panels will now correct themselves to their original positions if they get messed up due to resolution changes
 Hopefully fixed the issue with clan quests not always immediately resetting on day change
 Slightly modified how the Costs part of tasks with resources are displayed so that tasks with a lot of resource costs don't have their font sizes scaled down
 Boss runs will now end if a player leaves and the remaining member(s) are dead
 Fixed deaths in group combat sometimes leaving the dying player at non-zero health and the RIP panel not always appearing

notes.title: May 8th updates - Player to player item deliveries & more
notes.content:
Updates

 You're now able to send items to other players directly. This can be done from the item interaction popup from your inventory, the button is found right below the "Send to clan vault" button.
 Offline time of clan members is now displayed. Note that it won't be be shown for current members until they log in after this update.
 Potions button has been added to combat view

Changes

 When logging out during group combat, your character will now start progressing in offline combat as if it were solo
 The sell button in the item interaction popup is now red to draw extra attention to it to help prevent accidental item sales
 All metal armour have had their stats reduced
 Godlike gemstone drop rate has been dropped from 2% to 1%
 Astronomical ore drop rate has been dropped from 5% to 2%
 Superior and Outstanding gem droprates were decreased
 Smelting magic upgrade will no longer work on Astronomical ore
 Private messages can now be sent with the /dm prefix on top of /pm
 Removed pickaxe from tutorial rewards
 Cooking enchantment scrolls are back on the chest drop table menu (and will remain so, fixed the issue with database tools that caused the change to get overidden last time)
 Login buttons are now uninteractable for a short amount of time after log outs to prevent too quick relogins that could potentially cause some weirdness in connection processes
 Lots of time spent on backend improvements once again!

Fixes

 Fixed Dodge chance being applied to the "Enemy hit chance" calculation incorrectly. Taking this space to clarify how Dodge works:
 Your chance to dodge is the first thing processed when an enemy hits you. Let's consider a scenario where you have a 20% dodge chance and the enemy has a 75% chance to hit you. First, your odds to dodge are rolled. If you land within that 20%, you take 0 damage. If it fails, the rest of the enemy's damage calculations will be ran and you'll have a 25% chance to be hit a 0.
 Another attempted fix for Linux & Proton users. Currently unable to properly test it myself, so please do let me know if it works.
 Fixed combat offline progress not giving accurate results when using a potion of swiftness to reduce your attack speed. The modified attack speed wasn't factored in correctly and it was causing you to miss a lot of potential attacks during offline combat.
 The "reconnect to chat" overlay will no longer show up after relogs if you were previously timed out, as you are no longer timed out at that point.

notes.title: May 1st updates - In-app purchase & design changes, bug fixes & more
notes.content:
Changes


 In app purchase changes
- The Clan Credits boost in-app purchase has been disabled. It created an unfair field for clans to compete in and frankly made obtaining credits too easy for large, active clans.
- The Gemstone boost has been disabled. Similar reasoning as with credit boosts, the amount of gemstones introduced via the boost created unbalanced progression and a greater influx of gemstones than what I deem to be healthy for both the game's economy and individual player progression alike.
-  A new IAP that's more fair in nature has been added. The "Boss hunter" is a tradeable and consumable token that allows you to hold an unlimited amount of boss keys.
- When buying Premium membership tokens from other players, you will now need to pay a fee of 1M gold to make it tradeable again. This change is to prevent excessive flipping of the token which artificially drives up the price of tokens and makes it more difficult for new players to get their hands on premium.
 Boss changes
- Zeus has been buffed
- Only Zeus and Hades now drop Wands of Lifesteal. Titanium gloves and boots have been removed from their drop tables and are only obtainable from the other bosses.
 Smithing changes
- Coal is now required for all bars that are smithed into armour
- Armour smithing has had its base time raised from 3s to 9s
 Clan credits changes
- Credits per boss drop kill dropped from 20 to 12
- Credits per clan quest completion raised from 10 to 16
- Clan skilling quests will now only offer tasks up to level 50 instead of the previous 60. Additionally, the amounts required to complete tasks were lowered.
 Combat groups will no longer be disbanded when someone in the group leaves. Applies to both regular monsters and bosses.
 Removed hatchet and pickaxe from Local market
 Novice's wand was added to drop table of Druids
 Farming trickery upgrade prices have been rebalanced (now more expensive)
 The total level requirement to chat no longer applies to premium players
 Server optimizations, as usual


Fixes

 Fixed daily boosts not being claimable after the daily reset until you relogged
 Fixed Ninja upgrade not being applied to client side calculations
 "Leave/return to combat" overlay no longer overlaps with clan tabs
 Fixed "Leave/return to combat" overlay buttons overlapping with each other on some mobile aspect ratios
 Fixed an issue where you weren't able to start Carpentry tasks if you didn't have enough gold to pay for the tasks, even if the purchased Plank bargain upgrade made that untrue
 Potion of Trickery now only gets triggered on gathering tasks
 The "Already logged in" popup now won't close from background clicks to prevent misclicks, you'll now need to press decline or accept to continue
 Equipment boosts in profile now show 1 decimal place instead of doing weird rounding
 Fixed clan skills not gaining experience after level 80
 Godlike secateurs had a Fishing requirement instead of Foraging. Fixed.
 Fixed tasks sometimes showing an unnecessary amount of decimal points in experience gain
 Fixed Godlike refinements not receiving an experience boost from items
 Fixed a bug with Smelting magic upgrade giving less ore back than it should have during offline progression
 Fixed group combat edge-case bug causing groups to get disbanded. There might still be an issue with this - so far unable to find anything in testing but we'll see!
 Fixed loot from bosses not being displayed in solo runs (though it was given)

notes.title: Idle Clans has now been live for a week!
notes.content:
As many of you early players unfortunately found out, the server wasn't quite prepared to handle the amount of players we've had come play this week. It took a couple of days to get server fixed up to a decently stable place and it has now been mostly behaving well - even with the player count increasing every day since launch. Still, the work is on-going and you may experience some quirks from time to time.

By far the most time has been spent making server-side improvements, but there was time for some other updates as well. Here they are!

Changes & updates

 Player shops have had a slight rework
[olist]
 Recently modified shops are no longer shown, you can now search for items directly and find the cheapest deals available
 #marketplace-listings has at least for the time being been disabled. It promoted a pretty unhealthy trading environment and is no longer as needed with items being directly searchable in game now
 The notification received when a player buys your listed item is now only displayed for trades worth over 2.5K
[/olist]
 Chat timeout no longer applies to Clan and Combat group chats
 Chat timeout raised to 20 minutes
 New message notifications are now hidden when you get timed out from chat
 Enchantment scrolls have had their looks renewed. Once again a massive thanks to Madao for his incredible work!
 A "soft" popup is now triggered when a player buys your listed item instead of the disruptive "hard" popup (A soft popup is the small green popup that slides to your screen and a hard popup is any larger popup that needs to be manually closed. I shall from here on out in future posts use those terms without quotes or explanations).
 A ton of item icons have had their looks renewed! A massive thanks to Madao for redoing them, absolutely fantastic work!
 You will now be automatically timed out from the chat after 10 minutes if you don't interact with it (send messages). When you get timed out, you no longer receive chat messages until you press the reconnect button in the chat popup. I realize this is an inconvenience but as you can imagine each chatbox message being delivered to each connected player in the game every time adds a good amount of load to the server. I may raise the time required for timeout in the future.
 If you had all of the possible skill boosts available in the game, you would complete tasks much faster than what had been designed (woops). Skilling speed boosts have thus been temporarily hard-capped at 80% until the design is given a closer look.
 A number of backend improvements & alt prevention + detection
 Logs and planks no longer all use the same graphic. Big thanks to Madao for making the sprite variations!
 Global refinement announcements have been disabled all together
 Chat input field is no longer activated when receiving new messages
 Minigame boost IAP is now hidden if minigames aren't enabled
 Fixing an issue with group combat looting this update


Bug fixes

 Fixed typo in "Housing upgrade" text
 Fixed password field in lobby not accepting special characters when "show password" was toggled on
 Fixed an issue where if you started a task, logged out and then logged back in without the task completing at least once, the task wouldn't automatically resume
 Fixed an issue where the client assumed that a player shop purchase would go through if certain conditions were met before waiting for a response from the server
 When your item got purchased and you had several of the same item type for sale, the client would always select the first item of that type and give you the gold based on the listing price of that item. Just a visual bug, but it could cause some funky looking numbers until you relogged. Fixed.
 Player Shops had a bug where if you opened for example slot 1 of another players shop to buy a specific item, and the other player then changed the item in that slot before your purchase had been processed, you would buy the updated item when attempting to make a delayed purchase. Fixed.
 Fixed "ad" boost not being applied to combat experience
 Tier 5 cost of the Ammo-saver upgrade was incorrect, fixed
